items.title: How Big Is the AI Economy?
items.summary: OpenAI-style bubble talk is on a low ebb, so it's a good time to ask dispassionately: how big is the AI economy right now? Exponential View's new report says $175B annualized and growing 3x faster than any IT wave before it — while the headlines fill with identity checks, agent-neutrality bills, and a memory shortage nasty enough to earn the name Ramageddon.
